summary: Providers express concerns about the cost of maintaining E-Rate services and argue for shifting focus to CIPA compliance to save money

claims.argument: Providers argue that shifting focus from internet support to CIPA compliance will save money
claims.evidence_quote: I love the idea of erate shifting focus from supporting internet to supporting CIPA compliance.  We always thought it strange that erate required CIPA but did not support it.  My schools can go back to coax internet to save money there.
